upgrades.title: Better update experience
upgrades.summary: Updates now guide you clearly through backing up, downloading, installing, and finishing.

upgrades.title: Safer data protection
upgrades.summary: Your attendance records and preferences are better protected during app updates.

upgrades.title: More reliable offline use
upgrades.summary: The app is better prepared to keep working when your internet connection is unavailable.

upgrades.title: Clearer progress feedback
upgrades.summary: You can easily see what the app is doing while a backup or update is in progress.

upgrades.title: Simpler choices
upgrades.summary: You can update with a backup for extra peace of mind or update directly when you prefer.

upgrades.title: A more polished experience
upgrades.summary: Everyday screens and recovery steps feel smoother, clearer, and easier to follow.

fixes.title: Smarter reminders
fixes.summary: Reminders now avoid false alerts for holidays, days off, and completed classes.

fixes.title: More accurate upcoming classes
fixes.summary: Upcoming views now focus on classes that still need your attention.

fixes.title: More dependable updates
fixes.summary: The app stays on your current version until you choose to install an available update.

fixes.title: Safer reopening
fixes.summary: Closing the app during an available update keeps your current version ready when you return.

fixes.title: More trustworthy recovery
fixes.summary: The app does a better job of helping you return safely after an interrupted update or restore.

fixes.title: Smoother daily use
fixes.summary: Progress screens and common actions now feel more consistent and predictable.
